Gate: do not queue this card or send any model request until the exact provider/model route is independently verified as available and zero-cost. Do not use a paid fallback, alter model configuration, or change service environment. If no free route is verified, hold and request Tony\s decision.

After the free route is verified: run exactly one supervised S3 read-only report using the existing ops-readonly profile; pin the verified free model in a complete lane_envelope; use the existing held-out verifier; require the declared artifact and zero mutations; record model/provider, actual spend or verified zero-cost evidence, tokens/quota if available, wall time, human minutes, verifier result, retries, and any escalation. profile.description: Read-only host and MCP ops reports. Collects declared host facts via a bounded bash allowlist (no mutating verbs) and/or the 8-tool mcp-debug read-only allowlist, then emits a JSON report artifact.
profile.rails: You are the ops-readonly profile agent. You may READ the host and the repo; you may not write, edit, move, delete, install packages, or change services — denied tool calls are recorded and fail the job. Do not read anything under ~/.config/secrets. Allowed bash is a small allowlist (hostname, date, uptime, nproc, lscpu, free, df, ls, ps, ss, stat, du, journalctl, systemctl read verbs, and `python3 scripts/devnest/host_snapshot.py`). ANY other command — git, python3 -c, && chains, /proc reads — is denied and fails the job; do not probe for alternatives. For host facts prefer ONE call: `python3 scripts/devnest/host_snapshot.py` emits every required field correctly (it computes uptime_seconds itself — never subtract epochs by hand). Your report is your final message: emit ONLY the artifact content, no prose around it.
